texts.preamble: Shadab Alias Sadaab vs State Of Punjab on 8 January, 2026 1 Crm- Crm-M-72200- 72200-2025 216 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh Crm- Crm-M-72200- 72200-2025 Shadab @ Sadaab Petitioner ....Petitioner versus State of Punjab ....Respondent Date of decision: January 08, 2026 Date of Uploading: January 08, 2026 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sumeet Goel Present:- Present: Mr. Amitoj Singh Dhaliwal, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Hemant Aggarwal, Aag Punjab. ** * * * Sumeet Goel, Goel, J. (Oral)
texts.facts: Present petition has been filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') for grant of regular bail to the petitioner in case FIR No. No.214 dated 21.10.2025, for the offence punishable under Sections 318(4), 274 & 123 of the the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNS'), registered at Police Station Baghapurana, District Moga, Punjab. 2. The gravamen of allegations against the petitioner is that on 21.10.2025,, a police party from Police Station Baghapurana Baghapurana,, in the presence of Lavdeep Singh, Food Safety Officer, Office of the Civil Surgeon, Moga Moga,, conducted a raid at a residential premises. During the raid, 145 cardboard boxes of ghee bearing the brand name "Rudra", each containing 898 grams,, 1 of 4 CRM- Shadab Alias Sadaab vs State Of Punjab on 8 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176453341/ 1 CRM-M-72200- 72200-2025 and 46 cardboard boxes of ghee bearing the brand name "Sifti", each containing 898 grams, were recovered. In addition thereto, two tins of ghee weighing 15 kilograms each, four boxes of soybean refined oil, each box containing 10 packets, one packaging machine, and two bottles, one of which contained desi ghee flavour, were also recovered from the premises. The entire stock of ghee was found to be spurious/adulterated. The said recovery was effected from the premises where the petitioner was residing. The petitioner, along with co-accused, namely, Mohammad Bilal, Anish, and Vakeel Malik , was arrested at the spot along with the above-mentioned incriminating material.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has argued that the petitioner is in custody since 21.10.2025. Learned counsel has further argued that the petitioner has been falsely implicated into the FIR in question. Learned counsel has iterated that alleged recovery of spurious ghee cannot be attributed to the petitioner. Learned counsel has urged that the petitioner is a man with clean antecedents. Thus, regular bail is prayed for. 4. Learned State counsel has opposed the present petition by arguing that the allegations raised against the petitioner are serious in nature and, thus, the petitioner does not deserve the concession of the regular bail. Learned State counsel seeks to place on record custody certificate dated 07.01.2026 in the Court today, which is taken on record.
